text: どの　ポケモンに　でんじはを　おぼえさせるの？

structure.jp: でんじはを　おぼえさせるの？
structure.en: will you have learn Thunder Wave?

patterns.name: 〜させる
patterns.explanation: させる on a verb means making or letting someone do it; the one who does it gets に. ポケモンに　おぼえさせる = 'make a Pokémon learn it'.

patterns.name: 〜の (question)
patterns.explanation: の at the end with a rising voice is a soft, casual way to ask a question. おぼえさせるの？ = 'will you have it learn?'
